# Praanvayu

> Praanvayu (प्राणवायु, "breath of life") is an independent, citizen-led climate and public-health initiative working to reduce air pollution across India. People can volunteer by joining its WhatsApp community.

- Website: https://praanvayu.info/
- Join as a volunteer (WhatsApp community): https://chat.whatsapp.com/Cm92nCbNW0DE4THA9cEZMb
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/_praanvayu_/
- Goal: national average daily AQI below 100 by 2030 and below 50 by 2035.

## What the site covers

- [Overview](https://praanvayu.info/#overview): key facts, how to read India's AQI, the mission.
- [Learn](https://praanvayu.info/#air): what is in polluted air, what causes it, and what it does to health.
- [Protect yourself](https://praanvayu.info/#protect): a plan for any AQI, which masks work, sizing an air purifier.
- [Take action and volunteer](https://praanvayu.info/#act): everyday solutions, a pledge, reporting pollution, finding local officials anywhere in India, volunteer roles.
- [Resources and references](https://praanvayu.info/#resources): sources for every figure, and a glossary.

## Volunteer roles

- Clean Air Ambassador: Run awareness sessions in your colony, RWA, school, college or office, from reading the AQI to mask-fitting and pledge drives.
- Green cover drives: Plant and care for native trees (neem, peepal, arjun) and protect urban green belts.
- Burn-free campaigns: Work with farmers, waste workers and RWAs on alternatives to burning.
- Policy & research: Track NCAP city plans, file RTIs, log sensor readings to map local hotspots and prepare briefs for local officials.
- Design & storytelling: Make posters and reels, translate content into regional languages, and build maps and tools like this site.

## Questions and answers

### What is Praanvayu?

Praanvayu (प्राणवायु, “breath of life”) is an independent, citizen-led climate and public-health initiative working to reduce air pollution across India. Its goal is to bring the national average daily AQI below 100 by 2030 and below 50 by 2035, through awareness, community action and work with local governments.

### How can I volunteer for clean air in India?

Join the Praanvayu volunteer community on WhatsApp. There is no sign-up form: open the invite link, join the group, and pick the kind of work that suits you. You can take part from your own city, with whatever skills and time you have.

### What do Praanvayu volunteers do?

Volunteers choose from five roles: Clean Air Ambassador (awareness sessions in colonies, RWAs, schools, colleges and offices), green cover drives (planting and caring for native trees), burn-free campaigns (alternatives to burning waste and crop residue), policy and research (tracking NCAP city plans, filing RTIs, mapping local hotspots), and design and storytelling (posters, reels, translations, maps and tools).

### How much time do I need to give?

As much as you can spare, from an hour a month to leading a campaign in your city. No special background is needed.

### What can one person do about air pollution?

Start with your own habits: never burn garbage or leaves, walk, cycle, car-pool or use public transport where you can, and celebrate without firecrackers. Then act beyond your home: make your colony burn-free, report garbage burning, dust and industrial smoke on the CPCB’s SAMEER app, ask your councillor, MLA and MP what your city is doing under the National Clean Air Programme, and join others who are organising for clean air.

### How serious is air pollution in India?

Air pollution was linked to more than 20 lakh (2 million) deaths in India in 2023, according to the State of Global Air 2025 report. All 140 crore Indians live where annual PM2.5 is above the WHO guideline, and meeting that guideline would add about 3.5 years to average life expectancy in India and 8.2 years in Delhi, according to the Air Quality Life Index 2025.
